sentences.text: Christopher Ashton Kutcher -LRB- -LSB- ˈkʊtʃər -RSB- born February 7 , 1978 -RRB- is an American actor and investor .

Kutcher began his career as a model and began his acting career portraying Michael Kelso in the Fox sitcom That '70s Show , which aired for eight seasons .	Michael Kelso	Michael Kelso	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	That '70s Show	That '70s Show
He made his film debut in the romantic comedy Coming Soon and became known by audiences in the comedy film Dude , Where 's My Car ?	Coming Soon	Coming Soon (1999 film)
, which was a box office hit .

In 2003 , Kutcher appeared in romantic comedies Just Married and My Boss 's Daughter and , the same year , he created , produced , and hosted Punk 'd which aired on MTV for five seasons until its revival in 2012 .	Just Married	Just Married	MTV	MTV
In 2004 , Kutcher starred in the lead role of the psychological film The Butterfly Effect and gained public recognition .	The Butterfly Effect	The Butterfly Effect

Kutcher subsequently appeared in more romantic comedies , including Guess Who -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , A Lot Like Love -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , What Happens in Vegas -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , and No Strings Attached -LRB- 2011 -RRB- .	Guess Who	Guess Who (film)	A Lot Like Love	A Lot Like Love	What Happens in Vegas	What Happens in Vegas	No Strings Attached	No Strings Attached (film)
From 2011 to 2015 , he starred as Walden Schmidt on the CBS sitcom Two and a Half Men .	Walden Schmidt	Walden Schmidt	CBS	CBS	Two and a Half Men	Two and a Half Men
In 2013 , Kutcher portrayed Steve Jobs in the biographical film Jobs .	Steve Jobs	Steve Jobs	Jobs	Jobs (film)
